arcs.title: The Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters
arcs.summary: Day 1: Prentice-Hoole's successor body to the dissolved Subcommittee has now named itself — the Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters. It has met twice, agreed on the name, and proposed a working group to determine what 'adjacent matters' means. Tibbs has been invited in a non-voting capacity and has not yet replied. Day 2 should introduce the first substantive matter the Committee attempts to address — ideally something that edges toward Christine's territory without quite touching it yet.
